intro: The lowest-friction trip. Nonstop flights, two bedrooms near the centre and one driver day to take in the landscapes beyond the waterfront.
entry: Azerbaijan announced a tourist visa waiver for ordinary Saudi passports from 15 Feb 2026 to 15 Feb 2027, up to 30 days per visit and up to three visits. The official notice also describes airport visa-on-arrival eligibility for holders of qualifying Saudi residence permits valid for at least six months. Check each passport and permit.
winter: December historical average high/low 10°C / 4°C. Coastal wind can make the boulevard feel colder. Keep a museum in reserve. Mud-volcano access and mountain excursions depend on surface and weather conditions.

intro: The shortest city break, with holiday atmosphere and easy rail options. A Saturday morning arrival makes the five nights go further, and both published return options land in Medina early on 11 December.
entry: Visa depends on each traveler’s passport, residence permit and any existing Schengen visa. For ordinary Saudi passports, confirm a valid Schengen visa. The standard application lead time is at least 15 days; on 23 November departure was 12 days away.
winter: December historical average high/low 3°C / −2°C. Short daylight and damp cobblestones favor early castle views and market evenings. Seasonal context only; recheck actual conditions close to travel.
